title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime
summary: avatarin uses OpenAI’s GPT-Realtime to give Yamada Denki shoppers 24/7 multilingual support. In two weeks, 30,000 people used the agent and 92% of survey responses were positive.
body: avatarin uses OpenAI’s GPT-Realtime to give Yamada Denki shoppers 24/7 multilingual support. In two weeks, 30,000 people used the agent and 92% of survey responses were positive.
summaryZh: avatarin利用OpenAI的GPT-Realtime成功构建了一个全天候零售AI Agent，为Yamada Denki的购物者提供24/7的多语言支持服务。在短短两周内，该Agent便服务了3만名用户，并且获得了高达92%的积极正面调查反馈，充分展示了实时语音大模型在真实商业场景中的落地潜力与极高效率。
